pastDetails.title: Details for past conversations
pastDetails.text: In the sidebar, a conversation's ⋯ menu now shows its context, tokens, cost and tools, and can save them as a PDF.

madeForClaudeCode.title: Made for Claude Code
madeForClaudeCode.text: Runs the real claude CLI in fast, hardware-accelerated tabs and split panes, with every language and emoji rendering correctly.

approveAnywhere.title: Approve from anywhere
approveAnywhere.text: Background tabs ask for permission in Helm and in a Windows notification with Allow / Deny, plus Always allow for things you trust.

usageLimits.title: Usage limits
usageLimits.text: Live 5-hour and weekly meters with reset countdown, your pace, which tab used the most, and warnings at 80% and 95%.

agentsTab.title: Agents tab
agentsTab.text: Every Claude conversation grouped into Needs you, Working and Finished, with context, cost and what each one is doing (Ctrl+Shift+A).

usageAtAGlance.title: Usage and context at a glance
usageAtAGlance.text: Every limit with its reset time and your pace, today's and this week's cost and tokens, and per conversation what fills the context window. Save any of it as a PDF.

builtInBrowser.title: Built-in browser
builtInBrowser.text: Open your app beside the terminal, test phone and tablet sizes, and send errors, screenshots or any part of the page to Claude in one click.

filesOpenInHelm.title: Files open in Helm
filesOpenInHelm.text: Code with highlighting, Markdown, images, PDF, video and audio open as Helm tabs instead of other apps.

backgroundWork.title: See background work
backgroundWork.text: The side panel opens on Background when Claude starts a subagent, showing what it's doing and its final answer. Details lists screenshots, files and web pages used.

saveUsage.title: Save your usage
saveUsage.text: Usage history by day and project, a reminder to /compact as context fills, a warning before the cache expires, and big pastes attached as a file.

promptImprover.title: Prompt improver
promptImprover.text: Write a prompt, let Claude make it clearer, then send it (Ctrl+Shift+I).

tabStatus.title: Status on every tab
tabStatus.text: Working, needs approval or finished, with notifications for tabs you're not looking at.

historyAndPalette.title: History and palette
historyAndPalette.text: Search every conversation and continue it in one click. Ctrl+Shift+P for saved prompts, Claude commands, skills and actions.

reviewChanges.title: Review changes
reviewChanges.text: Side-by-side diffs, comments sent to Claude, and undo for a whole file or just one part.

parallelTasks.title: Parallel tasks
parallelTasks.text: Run Claude on several tasks at once, each in its own copy of the project on its own branch, then merge or remove them.

keepConversations.title: Conversations you don't lose
keepConversations.text: Tabs reopen the same conversations after a restart, and Ctrl+Alt+Shift+T reopens a closed tab.

statusBar.title: Clean status bar
statusBar.text: Permission mode, prompt cache timer, effort, git push/pull, pull request, usage, cost, context and model. Right-click to choose.

makeItYours.title: Make it yours
makeItYours.text: Accent colors, 10 terminal color schemes, Inter and JetBrains Mono built in, resizable panels, Ctrl+mouse wheel zoom and Windows 11 Mica.

claudeCodeSettings.title: Claude Code settings
claudeCodeSettings.text: Edit permissions, hooks, MCP servers and CLAUDE.md without touching JSON.

windowsDoneRight.title: Windows done right
windowsDoneRight.text: PowerShell 7, Windows PowerShell or Git Bash per tab, Windows hints for Claude, and screenshot paste with Ctrl+V.

private.title: Private by design
private.text: Everything stays on your PC. The only network request is the update check, and you can turn it off.

languages.title: Helm in your language
languages.text: Choose from 11 languages, the same ones Claude offers, in the gear menu or Settings › Appearance. Helm follows your Windows language by default.

voice.title: Voice input
voice.text: Hold Ctrl+Space or click the mic on a Claude tab and speak. Speech becomes text on your PC, nothing is sent anywhere, and it's typed into the prompt for you to send.

tools.title: Developer tools
tools.text: Color picker, image tools, screen ruler, JSON, encode and decode, regex tester, compare text, generators, time converter, placeholder text, ports in use, API tester, environment variables and a scratchpad.

screenshots.title: Screenshots
screenshots.text: Capture an area, a window, a freeform shape or the whole screen, with a delay or Ctrl+Alt+S from any app. Mark it up with arrows, boxes, text, numbered steps and blur, then copy, save or send it to Claude.

projects.title: Project files and a new sidebar
projects.text: Browse, search and edit a project's files without leaving Helm. The sidebar now shows projects with their conversations, with search, sort, color labels, a privacy blur, and a safe rename and delete.

phones.title: Phones for testing
phones.text: A connected Android phone shows in the status bar: mirror its screen, read your app's logs, take a screenshot or see its details.

settings.title: settings.json and a gear menu
settings.text: Edit Helm's settings as a file, with suggestions and checks, like VS Code (Ctrl+Shift+,). The gear now opens a menu with settings, theme, language, updates and help.

agents.title: Clearer Agents and Background
agents.text: The Agents page has Live and Usage tabs and a full view of each conversation. Background in the side panel shows subagents and commands with formatted answers, and finished commands no longer stay stuck as running.
